_notes.outcome_rules: Checked in order for the mission's goal symbol, using trades during the mission: (1) no buys -> never_bought; (2) realised P&L after fees > 0 -> passed_great if score >= grading.great_min_score, else passed_ok; (3) still holding shares -> still_holding; (4) otherwise -> sold_at_loss (includes breaking even). Score 0-100 = (avg sell - avg buy) / (highest price after the streak - lowest price before it).
_notes.placeholders: Missions 2-6 are placeholders. Copy marked TODO is not final.

missions.title: Buy low, sell high
missions.goal: Buy SGA, then sell it for a profit before the bell.
missions.hint: Watch the ticker - a player is heating up.

debrief.never_bought: The bell rang and your cash never left the bench. Safe? Sure. But SGA went on a heater and you watched from the stands. Next time: spot the move, buy in.
debrief.sold_at_loss: You bought and sold, so you're officially a trader! But you sold for less than you paid. Ouch. Buying after the big run-up, or panic-selling a small dip, are the classic traps.
debrief.still_holding: Nice buy! But you were still holding at the bell. Paper profits are like a forecast: nice to look at, not money yet. Selling is what locks it in.
debrief.passed_ok: Profit in the bag! You bought, you sold, you came out ahead. That's the whole game in one move. Can you catch more of the run next time?
debrief.passed_great: Huge! You caught the heater and sold near the top, before the hype cooled. The trading floor is applauding. Take a bow.

missions.lesson: You only make money when you sell for more than you paid - and hype doesn't last forever.
